void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, deep background layer — the absolute floor of the surface stack

carbon.$description: Carbon — Primary page background where pure black would be too harsh — the actual canvas color in the dominant layout

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card surfaces, nav bar, raised panels — the dominant mid-neutral

onyx.$description: Onyx — Subtle elevation layer between canvas and card

iron.$description: Iron — Box-shadow depth, elevated surface tint — provides warmth on hover and focus

slate.$description: Slate — Hairline borders on dense tables, row dividers

fog.$description: Fog — Low-emphasis borders, disabled control outlines

ash.$description: Ash — Muted body text, helper copy, link underlines — the workhorse mid-gray

pearl.$description: Pearl — Tertiary text, subtle heading tints

bone.$description: Bone — High-emphasis body text where pure white would vibrate against black

chalk.$description: Chalk — Display text, primary headings, icon strokes — the only text color permitted above #e5e5e5

signal-lime.$description: Signal Lime — Primary CTA fill, glowing borders, italic accent words in headlines — the single chromatic punctuation in an otherwise monochrome system; at 17.8:1 contrast against black it reads as emergency lighting

olive-depth.$description: Olive Depth — Dark green stroke for SVG world-map art and shadow glows under signal-lime elements

moss-shadow.$description: Moss Shadow — Deepest green used only as decorative stroke in dotted-globe illustrations

pt-serif.$description: All display headlines, hero copy, section titles, and the italic accent words — the editorial voice. Weight 300 is anti-convention for a crypto site; most use 600-700, this whisper-weight signals authority through restraint, not volume.

inter-tight.$description: All UI chrome, body paragraphs, buttons, nav, tags, labels, links. Carries 500 for nav emphasis, 600 for button text. The uppercase tracked-out labels (0.18–0.26em) read as classified-document metadata stamps.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Code snippets, protocol names, terminal output, hex strings — the proof-of-cryptography evidence layer

ui-monospace.$description: Inline monospace fallback, tiny hash strings, timestamps
